# `aitbc agent list`

List all local agents configured in the agent directory.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-dir` | path | — | no | Agent directory path |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent list
```
